name: app-error
title: AppError (full-screen error with retry CTA)
conventions_reminder: Full-screen centered error with error icon, message, and optional retry button
Retry button uses AppButton variant (secondary or tertiary preferred for errors)
All colors/spacings/radii/durations via tokens — no hardcoded values
Double quotes on all string literals
Top-of-file doc comment explaining purpose + state behavior
acceptance_criteria: Full-screen centered layout using Center + Column
Shows error icon with error color
Shows error title (default: 'Ops! Algo deu errado')
Shows retry button when onRetry is provided
completion_summary: Implemented AppError full-screen error widget with retry CTA following design system tokens
